official2027ProductPage.title: Women's Dream Weaver 2.0 Snowboard
official2027ProductPage.evidence: 2027 SKU shown as J.27.SNW.DRC; official US list price USD 549.95; sizes 139, 142, 145, 148, 151, 154, 156. Product copy describes resort freeride/all-mountain use, Directional outline, Freeride CamRock, Low Traction Tech, 5 mm taper, Medium 3D Contour Base, Master Core (Paulownia/Poplar), Biax fiberglass, Sintered 8000 base. Brand terrain/personality indicators: all-mountain 8/10, freeride/powder 10/10, freestyle/park 5/10, personality/flex 5/10; these are brand scales and are not mapped to the site's editorial_scores.

theGoodRide.title: Jones Dream Weaver 2.0 Snowboard Review by Jordan
theGoodRide.evidence: Reviewer disclosed multiple days on a borrowed/demo 148 cm sample, in packed groomers, spring conditions, hard setup snow, ice, corn and slush; rider 5 ft 6 in, 135-140 lb, women's boot size 8. This is the 2026 redesign demo, not an identified 2027 production sample. Reviewer says Jones expected the production board to be slightly stiffer; a note says the production version was slightly stiffer but did not change its progression range. Observations: easy/quick turns, accessible flex, manageable occasional park use and jumps; support, edge hold and composure decline when speed/turning forces rise, with weak damping on firm uneven snow. The reviewer explicitly did not test true powder and does not recommend it as a dedicated deep-snow board; float assessment is therefore a geometry-based prediction, not a powder ride test. The review mentions a 6.8 m sidecut for its demo 148, while the J.27 official size table lists 7.1 m for production 148; keep the demo geometry separate and use the official J.27 figure in the seed. External categories are qualitative and not numerically mapped to local six-dimensional scores.

units.weight: kg as shown by Jones; pound equivalents are also shown on source page
units.linearDimensions: cm unless key says sidecut or taper

sizeTable.fieldNotes: This transcription preserves the published per-size table, including surface area, contact length, tip/tail lengths and widths, front/back underfoot widths, centered stance, and weight/boot ranges. These fields are not all represented by the current single-representative-size seed schema.

scoreReview.decision: No numerical score changed in this batch. The independent ride evidence is a 2026 demo with a production-flex caveat, not a confirmed 2027 production test; there is no matching Dream Weaver 2.0 product entry in apps/web/src/data/boards.ts to keep prototype and YAML scores in parity. Retain as provisional, low-to-medium confidence editorial estimates. Float has especially low direct-test confidence because the reviewer reports no true-powder test; value has low confidence because the seed CNY figure is only an FX normalization of the US regional listed price.

dimensionEvidence.stability: low-to-medium: slower/low-angle stability reported; higher force/speed and firm uneven snow expose flex/damping limits; demo-to-production flex caveat remains.
dimensionEvidence.response: medium: easy, quick turn initiation reported, but high-load carving support is limited.
dimensionEvidence.float: low: directional geometry and official powder positioning only; no true powder ride test.
dimensionEvidence.park: low: occasional park and several jumps described as manageable; not a dedicated park design.
dimensionEvidence.forgiveness: medium: easy turns and soft, approachable feel reported, chiefly for beginner/intermediate riders.
dimensionEvidence.value: low: no verified China-market price or local comparable set.
